3863.title: Native Linux desktop crash investigation
3863.rootCauseOneLine: Native faulting check remains unidentified; no matching Linux runtime or usable symbolized crash was available.
3863.proposedFix: Collect a symbolized native crash in an isolated Linux graphical environment before changing production code.
3863.caveats: Second clean checkout confirmed prerequisite failures only. macOS ARM64 cannot reproduce the Linux crash; host pnpm launcher is broken.
